title: Responsible timber
body: Timber is sourced from agroforestry plantations with strict traceability, reflecting a commitment to sustainability.

title: Veneer preparation
body: Veneers are calibrated to help eliminate warping, blisters and gaps. In MR Value – Accurate 16mm, tenderised veneers route cleanly for CNC grooves.

title: Preservation
body: MR Eco & Gold Grade receives vacuum-impregnated anti-termite and borer protection (ATBS). MR Value uses GLT preservation for fungal resistance.

title: Bonding
body: Power Seal adhesive bonds the layers. MR Value – Accurate 16mm integrates Power Seal through the core with BWP-type resin.

title: Pressing & calibration
body: Boards are pressed and calibrated to precise thickness — MR Value – Accurate 16mm is held to ±0.2mm.

title: Fire-retardant treatment
body: For Fireguard FR Ply, fire-retardant chemicals are pressure infused and surface coated while keeping the natural finish intact.
